title: Quaint Yeasty Venezuelan Comte Wrap
description: A yeasty, shaggy, meal-prep Venezuelan dish featuring comte, ssam-wrap, and kosher-friendly ingredients, perfect for a snack or lunch.
instructions: Roll out the yeast dough to a large sheet, about 1/4 inch thick.
Place the dough on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Brush the dough with olive oil and sprinkle with salt and black pepper.
Arrange the sliced comte cheese on one half of the dough, leaving a 1 inch border around the edges.
Top the cheese with chopped cilantro, sliced avocado, and sliced tomato.
Fold the other half of the dough over the filling to form a half-moon shape.
Place the ssam wrap sheets on top of the dough, pressing gently to adhere.
Bake the wrap in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until the dough is golden brown.
Remove the wrap from the oven and let it cool for 5 minutes before slicing and serving.
